name: PR Overview shows the seeded PR brief, deep-links a focus row into Files changed and opens the brief's run trace
description: From the seeded repo's PR list, open PR #482 and confirm the PR brief card (the review's Request changes verdict, the seeded summary, the cost line), the Risk areas chip in the Intent card and the Review focus rows; reload to confirm the stored brief shows again. Then click a focus row to land on Files changed with file and line in the URL and the file open, return to Overview and click the cost line to open the run trace titled PR Brief. Nothing generates a brief, so no model call. Exercises GET /pulls/:id/brief, the deep link and the run trace of a brief run.
